bass.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play a palm-muted, syncopated riff in E minor at 120 BPM. The drum kit features a prominent open hi-hat on the off-beats and a heavy snare on beats 2 and 4. An overdriven bass guitar doubles the guitar riff. The arrangement utilizes a 4/4 time signature. The guitar tone is characterized by high gain and mid-range scoop. The track maintains a consistent rhythmic drive with eighth-note chugging on the low E string.

[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, palm-muted syncopation]
[bass guitar enters, doubling guitar riff]

[Main Section]
[drums enter, open hi-hat on off-beats, heavy snare on 2 and 4]
[rhythmic chugging on low E string]
[crash cymbal accents]

drums.tags: Funk-rock fusion with heavy slap bass and syncopated percussion. The arrangement features a prominent electric bass guitar utilizing thumb-slap and finger-pop techniques, locking into a 16th-note groove with the kick drum. A clean-toned electric guitar plays rhythmic muted scratches and staccato chords on the off-beats. The drum kit consists of a tight, high-tuned snare and a dry kick drum. A Hammond B3 organ provides sustained chordal textures in the background. The tempo is 112 BPM in 4/4 time, centered in the key of E minor.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[slap bass riff, muted electric guitar scratches]
[tight snare and kick drum enter]

[Main Theme]
[syncopated bass line with finger pops]
[staccato electric guitar chords on the upbeats]
[Hammond B3 organ swells]

[Bridge]
[bass guitar solo with heavy 16th-note ghost notes]
[drum fills on high-tuned toms]

[Outro]
[sustained organ chord]
[final bass slap and snare hit]

vocals.tags: Blues rock instrumental. A distorted electric guitar performs a lead melody using heavy vibrato, wide string bends, and rapid pentatonic runs. A second electric guitar provides rhythmic accompaniment with crunchy overdrive, playing syncopated double-stops and blues turnarounds. The bass guitar follows a walking blues pattern in eighth notes. The drum kit features a prominent shuffle feel on the ride cymbal with a snappy snare on the backbeat. 120 BPM. Key of E Major. 4/4 time signature.
